{{Vanilla|Bowl}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''bowl''' is a container for meals. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] it is a ceramic bowl made from [[brick]]s and is needed for bowl meals such as curries, ramen and stroganoff.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Five bricks make 4 bowls; the vanilla recipe from planks is removed. Getting one grants the advancement "Manners First".<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/bowl.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Bowls are used in many meals: curries and ramen cooked in an [[oven]] or on [[Kindling|kindling]], and crafted dishes such as stroganoff, oatmeal and pad thai. See [[Food]].
